subject: authentication by passing output through php

messages.author: e569f9ca5b5a4235
messages.subject: authentication by passing output through php
parts:
Hi all,

I've seen a couple approaches to authentication here.  I have a question about my proposed workflow.

- Website built using wordpress on apache.  Authentication is handled using Paid Memberships Pro plugin
- modify htaccess so that access to shiny is restricted by a php script that checks if the person has the proper membership level (calls into wordpress)
(http://wordpress.org/support/topic/plugin-paid-memberships-pro-downloadable-products-reoccuring-payments, https://github.com/strangerstudios/paid-memberships-pro/blob/dev/services/getfile.php)

At the bottom of my modified gatekeeper script would be a call like header('Location: index.html');.  Ideally, index.html would contain the output of shiny server.

I think it would be possible in this case to do html-ui for shiny, but I don't know anything about html.  I'd prefer to stick with ui.R because it looks good for my purposes.  How can I pass the output of ui.R to the header call in php?  I guess I don't understand how shiny server and node.js generates the code sent to the browser.

Thanks,
Joe

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: authentication by passing output through php
parts:
Hi Joseph,

The value of the Location header is just a URL. So you should be able to just pass back the relative or absolute URL for your Shiny app.

(That said, I don't know enough about your setup to endorse the workflow you've proposed. There will only be a couple of approaches to authentication that we officially bless, and only on the Pro edition of Shiny Server.)
